'''Narissa Delau''' was working in the [[Imperial Reclamation Service]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. She was part of an [[Reclamation Service Yavin 4 expedition|expedition]] to [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] that uncovered a set of Sith relics from the era of [[Exar Kun/Legends|Exar Kun]]. The group was attacked by a [[Massassi/Legends|Massassi]], who killed [[Harris (Yavin 4)|Harris]] and scattered the rest. Recovering from her wounds, Doctor Delau received word from her superior [[Talos Drellik]] that the [[Alliance Commander]] was coming to investigate the situation and prepared a report describing their finding for them.<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Fallen Empire]]''</ref>
